ai_review.summary: Restored soundboard captures a superb 1971 performance with the surprise Johnny B. Goode finale.
ai_review.review: The reviewers rave about the immaculate restoration, noting that every tuning note and DJ comment is crystal‑clear, which points to an excellent soundboard source. Musically the show is celebrated for its energy and the unexpected encore of “Johnny B. Goode,” leaving listeners wishing they could have seen the band’s reaction.

ai_rating.rationale: A single, highly enthusiastic review praises both the performance and the restored audio quality, indicating an exceptional show with excellent recording; however confidence is limited by the small sample size.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Restoration praised; tuning notes, DJ commentary and audience demand are clearly audible, indicating a clean, well‑balanced mix.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Surprise encore ending with Johnny B. Goode adds an exciting climax to the set.
